Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut) * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce * ¼ cup chicken broth * ¼ cup Dijon mustard * 3 tbsp honey * 2 tbsp olive oil * 4 cloves garlic, minced or pressed * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp dried thyme Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Place the chicken breasts in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Season both sides with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. In a small bowl, whisk together all of the sauce ingredients until smooth. Pour most of the sauce over the chicken, reserving about ¼ cup for later. Coat the chicken evenly. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake:  * Thin-cut chicken breasts: 20–25 minutes  * Regular or thick chicken breasts (or thighs): 30–40 minutes 5. 10-15 min before chicken is done remove from the oven, add the vegetables, and drizzle the reserved sauce over the top. 6. Return to the oven uncovered for the 10-15 minutes remaining or until the vegetables are tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Serve with roasted potatoes, rice, or your favorite side. Enjoy! #fyp #easydinner #recipes

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

it’s DELISH! trust 🤝 Easy Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowls Ingredients * 2 cups rice * 1 (13.5 oz) can full-fat coconut milk * 1 can water (use the empty coconut milk can to measure) * 2 chicken breasts * Teriyaki sauce (I use the Aldi brand!) * Paprika * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Salt & pepper * 4 mini cucumbers * 1 avocado * 1 lime * Olive oil Instructions 1. Preheat your oven to 450°F. 2. Lightly coat a sheet pan with olive oil, making sure to cover the bottom and sides (I like using a brush for this). 3. Add the 2 cups of rice, the can of coconut milk, and 1 can of water to the sheet pan. Stir everything together, then cover tightly with aluminum foil—you want it sealed well so the rice steams. 4. Bake the rice for 10 minutes. 5. While the rice starts cooking, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Toss with teriyaki sauce until well coated. 6. Spread the chicken onto a second sheet pan. 7. After the rice has baked for 10 minutes, add the chicken to the oven. Bake both for 15 more minutes (the rice will cook for 25 minutes total). 8. While everything cooks, dice the cucumbers and avocado. Toss with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt. 9. Assemble your bowls with the coconut rice, teriyaki chicken, and cucumber-avocado mixture. Drizzle with extra teriyaki sauce before serving—it makes it even better! 🤤
